rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being without a job or joblessness in general.

example.english: A lot of people are facing unemployment these days, and finding a job is really difficult.
example.traditional: 呢排好多人失業，搵工真係好難。
example.jyutping: nei1 paai4 hou2 do1 jan4 sat1 jip6 wan2 gung1 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4

rows.note: Use this when unemployment is expressed as a measured percentage or rate in an economy.

example.english: The unemployment rate in this area has risen to five percent, and the economy is really struggling.
example.traditional: 呢區失業率升到百分之五，經濟真係麻麻。
example.jyutping: ni1 keoi1 sat1 jip6 leot6 sing1 dou3 baak3 fan1 zi1 ng5 ging1 zai3 zan1 hai6 maa4 maa4
